buses.note: TEST SUBSET (82 of 2696 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: 2696 buses minted by single-linkage snapping of kept HIFLD line endpoints within 300 m (a bus may span more; widest member offset 384 m from its centroid); lat/lon = centroid; numbered by sorted (lat, lon). name = the SUB_1/SUB_2 value shared by lines meeting there or fixed by elimination along a line (445 named); placeholders (TAP*/UNKNOWN*/RISER*/DEADEND*/NOT AVAILABLE/NONE) are left blank. ba_plant_id/ba_plant_km = the nearest EIA-860 plant that set the footprint label; component = connected-component rank (always 1: islands are dropped). 450 gen buses carry 93487.8 MW of EIA-860 operating (OP/SB) nameplate from 567 SWPP plants snapped to the nearest bus within 25 km; 84 SWPP plants (3861.9 MW) were farther and are not attached, 5 lack a location. Other buses are role=load with uniform weight 1.0: there is no public nodal load.

congestion.note: TEST SUBSET (42 of 1601 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: SPP Day-Ahead market only (no real-time), 2025, one row per constraints row. hours_binding = distinct UTC hours (GMTIntervalEnd) the flowgate was BINDING or BREACHED; breached_hours counts BREACHED. Local Interval labels repeat on the DST fall-back hour; those are distinct UTC hours with their own shadow prices and are kept. Exact duplicate rows (GMTIntervalEnd, Constraint Name, Monitored Facility, Contingency Name) removed: 0 (0 with differing values; first kept). shadow_price_sum_usd_per_mw = sum of |shadow price| over those hours, in $/MW (not $): SPP posts no $ congestion figure and the ratings needed for rent are not public, so monthly_cost_musd is blank.

constraints.note: TEST SUBSET (42 of 1601 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: SPP DA binding constraints 2025: 1951 flowgates (Constraint Name|Contingency Name) in 136303 hourly rows. Kept 1601: 1588 thermal (LN monitored element) and 13 interface (11 Multi-Element, 2 with a blank monitored element: SOONER_SONR_SONR_PHSHFT_PS|BASE, TEXAS_CO_TXPS_TXCO_PHSHFT_PS|BASE; the blank ones are named as phase-shifter (PHSHFT_PS) constraints and are classed interface per the table contract). Excluded 350 transformer (XFMR) flowgates: 28928 constraint-hours, 21.0% of total |shadow price| over all flowgates. 719 distinct monitored lines (endpoint order ignored). 6 flowgates carry >1 monitored-facility spelling, 6 of them only reversed endpoints (CAMPBLCO_GLENHBISMA23_1_1_LN|BASE, COMS_AMR_COMS_SKST_7513_A_LN|BASE, DEVAUL_DEVAUNSALE11_1_1_LN|BASE, NORTON_C_MARS_NORTON1_1_LN|BASE, PAT_WX_FULTON_PATMO_A_LN|BASE, SUB1399_1500_1_LN|BASE); 48 carry >1 contingent-facility spelling; each is one row with the most frequent spelling (ties: first sorted). 0 flowgates mix element types (classed by the most frequent). monitored_facility is the corridor key: lines with endpoints sorted, multi-element interfaces suffixed with their constraint name; SPP's spelling is kept in monitored_facility_as_reported. Monitored elements not resolved to public topology: monitored_line and contingency_line are blank for every row (SPP names are market-model bus names; the bus-location model is CEII); contingency_line is also inherently blank for the 183 BASE (no-contingency) flowgates.

ferc1_lines.note: TEST SUBSET (26 of 1898 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: FERC Form 1 schedule 422 via PUDL v2024.11.0 out_ferc1__yearly_transmission_lines_sched422 (version = versioned S3 path; the parquet carries none), report_year 2023 (latest in the release). Respondents: 18 configured; kept rows by utility_id_ferc1: 195=65, 205=389, 206=510, 225=61, 230=135, 249=21, 254=166, 255=53, 273=80, 314=124, 315=30, 332=2, 341=8, 343=6, 354=97, 356=151; filed but no usable rows: 196, 446. Source rows 2234; kept 1898; dropped 336 (no_voltage 150, no_length 42, missing_endpoint 144; first failing check in that order). Flags on kept rows: both_length_columns 93, capex_zero 48, kv_in_volts 21, same_endpoints 26. same_endpoints/aggregate_name rows are group or structure-class summaries: kept for audit, never joined. kv_in_volts: kV reported in volts divided by 1000 (voltage_as_reported keeps the filing). length_mi = stand-alone + aggregated pole-miles: 26,435.6 + 782.5 = 27,218.1 mi on kept rows, 25,909.5 mi excluding summary rows; both_length_columns rows (often a second circuit on shared structures) count both columns. cost_usd = capex_total (float32 in PUDL; blank when null or 0, flag capex_zero). thermal_limit_mw blank: Form 1 reports no rating. HIFLD join (both normalized endpoint names, either order, + voltage, exactly one line, one FERC row per line): exact 25 rows, 1,167.0 mi = 4.5% of non-summary miles; ambiguous 62 (6 with several HIFLD candidates, 56 sharing one HIFLD line with another FERC row, e.g. one line filed as structure/state segments or by two respondents); none 1811. Unmatched rows keep a blank line_id. Respondent filings include lines outside SPP (e.g. NorthWestern Montana, Basin, SPS New Mexico); only the HIFLD join places a row in the footprint. Non-filers (NPPD, OPPD, LES, WFEC, GRDA, Sunflower, Midwest Energy, WAPA, munis/co-ops) file no schedule 422: unobserved, never zero.

hifld_lines.note: TEST SUBSET (80 of 3429 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: 17665 HIFLD Open features in the hifld_envelope; excluded 11 (dc=2, inactive=7, under_construction=2; first matching reason in order bad_id, duplicate_id, dc, inactive, under_construction, unknown_kv, below_min_kv, bad_geometry); kept non-DC lines >= 100 kV not INACTIVE/UNDER CONSTRUCTION. 25 multipart lines chained by nearest free end (3 sub-1 m stub parts dropped; widest gap 244 m, never counted in length). Endpoints snapped within 300 m; 2402 self-loops dropped. Footprint: each endpoint bus takes the balancing authority of its nearest located EIA-860 2024 operating plant (12451 plants with a BA, all BAs); 3578 lines have both ends SWPP, dropped 410 with one end SWPP (seams) and 11264 with neither. Of those, the 58 pieces outside the largest connected piece were dropped (149 lines, 203 buses, 928.1 mi; e.g. a mislabelled plant pulling a few foreign buses in, or pieces cut off by a dropped seam line), so the network is one connected piece: 3429 lines kept. OWNER is not used as a filter (943 kept lines have OWNER=NOT AVAILABLE). length_mi is haversine along the WGS84 polyline (38778.2 mi total).

load_930.note: TEST SUBSET (4 of 4 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: SWPP 2024 hourly demand from the EIA-930 six-month bulk CSVs (no API key): 8784 of 8784 hours have demand. load_mw is 'Demand (MW) (Adjusted)' when present, else 'Demand (MW)' (8784 adjusted hours). peak/offpeak = max/min demand hour, shoulder = lower-median demand hour, windhigh = max wind share of adjusted net generation (Jul-Dec wind = with + without integrated battery storage); ties go to the earliest UTC hour.

queue.note: TEST SUBSET (34 of 680 rows) of real snapshot 2026-10-12. Original note: SPP GI active queue CSV (spp_giq_2026-10-09): 1017 requests.
